_about: Public-domain Gottlieb Lünemann (1819-1894, Göttingen) in English for the Word Hoard: his two volumes in Meyer's Critical and Exegetical Commentary, Thessalonians, tr. Paton J. Gloag (1880), and Hebrews, tr. Maurice J. Evans (1882), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
